liz_support: FYI customer reported a sudden invoice surge tied to streaming usage. dashboard shows ~2.3K tokens, invoice shows ~8.9K. They attached SSE transcript and say it spikes right after a client reconnect. invoice: INV-2026-031.
liz_support: attaching snippet they sent (redacted keys). asking for quick repro + root cause so billing can decide credits. :thinking_face:
rahul_eng: can you paste the raw SSE frames they logged? specifically looking for repeated prefix/trailer frames or re-dispatched payloads.
liz_support: here you go:
```
event: token_chunk
data: {"stream_id":"s-7a1","tokens":320,"chunk_index":0}

event: token_chunk
data: {"stream_id":"s-7a1","tokens":120,"chunk_index":1}

# client disconnects here (tcp close)
# server reconnect/replay
event: token_chunk
data: {"stream_id":"s-7a1","tokens":320,"chunk_index":0}

event: token_chunk
data: {"stream_id":"s-7a1","tokens":200,"chunk_index":2}

event: final
data: "done"

```
liz_support: customer says they close the client mid-generation and reconnect; dashboard counts only first stream_id occurrence but ledger counted both replays.
rahul_eng: hm. two hypotheses: 1) server replay during redispatch is producing identical chunk_index 0 which our ledger treats as new tokens because stream_id matches but no idempotency guard; 2) client-side resume semantics trick ledger into double-append.
rahul_eng: can you share the pairing log entries for ledger events idempotency check? sre-bot: trace attached: trace-id=trc-9f2c
sre-bot: Redispatch log: 
```
[2026-03-10T18:22:01Z] dispatch: session=s-7a1 attempt=1 tokens=440
[2026-03-10T18:22:09Z] session closed: reason=tcp_reset
[2026-03-10T18:22:10Z] redispatch: session=s-7a1 attempt=2 tokens=520 replayed_chunks=[0,1]
[2026-03-10T18:22:15Z] commit: ledger_event=ledg-553 tokens=960
```
rahul_eng: looks like the ledger commit happens after redispatch and sums both attempts. we should have guarded by a per-stream-finalization token or an idempotency token per chunk. current ledger only dedups by (session, chunk_index) when session_id is unique — but session_id here is reused.
marco_devex: customer workaround: add a unique client-provided resume_id that the server passes through to ledger and dedups on (resume_id, chunk_index). quick patch in server side should reduce duplicates.
jamie_billing: invoice INV-2026-031 has a +6.6K token delta vs dashboard. if engineering confirms duplicate counting, billing will propose a pro-rated credit. need eng confirm and bug id.
rahul_eng: creating internal bug BUG-3421: "ledger double-count on SSE redispatch when session reused" assigning to me. repro steps I used:
1) start stream with `curl --no-buffer -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=x"`
2) read first two chunks, then simulate client tcp close (`kill -9` the curl process)
3) immediately reconnect with same session token; server triggers redispatch and replays chunk 0
4) observe ledger commit includes both attempts.
rahul_eng: quick mitigation options:
- short-term: have ledger ignore duplicate chunk_index within last 10s for same session token (fast hotspot fix)
- mid-term: require server to emit `final` event with `final_offset` and ledger marks stream finalized before allowing replays
- long-term: add `resume_id` and dedup on (resume_id, chunk_index)
marco_devex: can we push short-term guard behind a feature flag? ops would prefer that.
rahul_eng: yes, will open a PR with FF (ledger.dedupe_on_reconnect=true) — rolling patch to prod tomorrow AM.
jamie_billing: please confirm PR link and estimated time window so we can notify customer and prepare credit estimate.
rahul_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/987 (draft). ETA for rolling patch: 2026-03-11 09:00 PT.
liz_support: noted. I'll reply to customer: explain cause (replay after reconnect), say eng will deploy a guard tomorrow, and billing will provisionally hold invoice while we confirm.
jamie_billing: I'll prepare provisional credit calc: disputed_tokens = invoice - dashboard = 6600, provisional credit = prorated on usage tier, will wait for final eng confirmation before applying.
marco_devex: one more note for dev docs: recommend streaming best-practice snippet — always send `final` event and use `resume_id` for resume semantics. I'll add to docs repo.
liz_support: thanks all — marking thread for follow-up after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
